ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: "Collections combined successfully", environmentsProcessed: sizeOf(vars.environmentFiles default []), collectionsProcessed: sizeOf(vars.collectionFiles), timestamp: now() }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: error.description, message: "Failed to combine collections", timestamp: now() }

set-variable.doc:name: Initialize Combined Collection
set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- {info: {name: "Combined Collection - " ++ vars.environmentName, description: "Flattened and combined collection with " ++ vars.environmentName ++ " environment values", schema: "https://schema.getpostman.com/json/collection/v2.1.0/collection.json"}, item: []}]

set-variable.doc:name: Append Requests
set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.combinedCollection update {case .item -> vars.combinedCollection.item ++ payload}]

set-variable.doc:name: Initialize Combined Collection
set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- {info: {name: "Combined Collection - No Environment", description: "Flattened and combined collection without environment variable substitution", schema: "https://schema.getpostman.com/json/collection/v2.1.0/collection.json"}, item: []}]
